prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: local registered crop of an existing HD 2D RPG terrain background, not a new scene. Preserve EXACT framing, camera high-oblique top-down projection, major landmarks, all openings and road centerlines and the image border continuity. This is a traversable ground road. Refine its art so the portal approach feels naturally worn into the existing landscape. Sharply resolved hand-painted pixel-art game texture with restrained clustered detail, crisp broken edges and stone planes, not photorealism, not blur or plastic smooth rounded pillows. Match original palette and light direction. Do not add text, signs, people, arrows, portals, architecture, fences, impassable debris or new elevations. Keep the central walking corridor entirely clear. Preserve the outermost 5% border as closely as possible so this edited crop registers seamlessly onto the full original map. Edit the horizontal cobblestone path only and its immediate grass edges. Keep same left/right exits and lower branching footpath. Replace the overly large rounded pale boulders with smaller, flat weathered grey-ochre cobbles half embedded in packed warm earth, sparsely chipped and mossy along the banks. Vary the edge with low grass growing into dirt gaps; stone density thins organically toward the wooded left exit, dappled leaf shadows. No continuous hard curb or uniform parallel outline. Keep exact path width, bottom dirt spur, trees and broad grass areas. Left edge path remains open and horizontal.
